triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue clearly reports that SessionEndReason.Logout enum value in packages/core/src/hooks/types.ts is defined but never triggered during authentication logout/signout.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix requires adding a call to fireSessionEndEvent(SessionEndReason.Logout) in authLogoutCommand in packages/cli/src/ui/commands/authCommand.ts and adding a corresponding unit test in packages/cli/src/ui/commands/authCommand.test.ts.

summary.problem: The SessionEndReason.Logout enum value exists in core hook types but is never triggered when logging out in Gemini CLI.
summary.root_cause: The authLogoutCommand action in packages/cli/src/ui/commands/authCommand.ts clears cached credentials and settings but does not invoke config.getHookSystem().fireSessionEndEvent(SessionEndReason.Logout).
summary.context: SessionEndReason.Logout was included for ending sessions on authentication changes, but the command handling user signout/logout was missing the hook invocation.

steps: In the action handler of authLogoutCommand, retrieve the hook system via context.services.agentContext?.config?.getHookSystem().
Invoke hookSystem.fireSessionEndEvent(SessionEndReason.Logout) during logout execution before returning.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Executing the auth signout/logout subcommand action should fire the SessionEnd hook event with SessionEndReason.Logout.
verification_steps: In packages/cli/src/ui/commands/authCommand.test.ts, mock or spy on hookSystem.fireSessionEndEvent.
Assert that calling the logout command action calls fireSessionEndEvent with SessionEndReason.Logout.
